title: Exceptional Set in the abc Conjecture
abstract: Formalizes reductions and optimization bounds for a power-saving estimate on exceptional triples in the abc conjecture.

informal.abcConjecture_iff_countTriples: Recasts the abc conjecture as a uniform big-O bound for bounded exceptional triples.
informal.refinedCountTriplesStar_isBigO_B: Bounds the refined exceptional-triple count by the dyadic structured-box supremum.
informal.thm_4_point_3: Derives the Section 4 optimization bound from the determinant, geometry, and Fourier hypotheses.
